context: Tests whether setup derives the search criteria from an existing job-apply workspace rather than interviewing the user. The application log already encodes which platforms they use, the titles they apply under, and which companies cap applications, so re-asking is the failure. Inferences must be shown for confirmation rather than written silently, and the existing profile must not be rewritten.

checklist.name: Reused the existing workspace
checklist.description: Resolved the workspace via the .job-apply/config.yaml marker and did not create a second workspace or a second marker file

checklist.name: Created the pipeline with the right header
checklist.description: search/pipeline.csv exists and its header is exactly the 16 documented columns, in the documented order

checklist.name: Mined ATS slugs from the log
checklist.description: known_company_boards contains at least four ATS slugs extracted from the URLs in applications/log.csv, in the host:slug form, rather than asked for or invented

checklist.name: Ordered sources by observed use
checklist.description: The sources order reflects the platform counts mined from the log, most-used first, rather than an arbitrary or alphabetical order

checklist.name: Query terms include the recorded targets
checklist.description: query_terms_fde includes titles taken from profile/targets.md

checklist.name: Surfaced titles found only in the log
checklist.description: Surfaced at least one title that appears in the application log but not in profile/targets.md, and asked whether to adopt it rather than adopting it silently

checklist.name: Mined the application caps
checklist.description: company_cooldown includes at least one company whose notes in the log mention an application cap or quota

checklist.name: Derived geography and showed the derivation
checklist.description: geography and exclude_locations were derived from profile/logistics.md, and the derivation was shown to the user for confirmation rather than written silently

checklist.name: Did not interview at length
checklist.description: Asked four or fewer questions, batched into a single interaction. In particular did not re-ask which target roles the user wants, since targets.md already records them

checklist.name: Left the existing profile untouched
checklist.description: profile/targets.md and profile/logistics.md are byte-identical to the fixture after the run, and nothing was written to applications/ or cv/

checklist.name: Reported what it did
checklist.description: Reported where the files were created and what was mined from the log
